designInfo.interventionModelDescription: Participants will receive a single dose of TSHA-102 at a dose level of 1.0×10¹⁵ total vector genomes (vg) adjusted for the participant's brain volume. TSHA-102 will be administered via lumbar puncture (LP). The study comprises a screening period, TSHA-102 administration, a primary safety analysis period through 25 weeks post TSHA-102 administration, and an extended follow-up observation period through 5 years post TSHA-102 administration.
